1.What is delivered

You receive one personalised Lal Kitab Report of about 65 pages as a PDF file, prepared from the birth details you submit. No physical product, printed copy or CD is sent.

2.How it is delivered
To the WhatsApp number you give at checkout, and
To the email address you give at checkout.

The PDF opens on any phone or computer. You can also print it.

3.Delivery time
Situation	Delivery time
Normal orders with complete birth details	24–48 hours from successful payment
Birth details missing or unclear	24–48 hours from when you send the complete details

The delivery time starts once Razorpay confirms your payment.

4.Delivery charges

There are no shipping or delivery charges. The price of ₹581 includes GST and delivery.

5.Where we deliver

Because the Report is delivered online, we can deliver to customers anywhere in India and abroad, as long as you can receive WhatsApp messages or email. Payments are accepted in Indian Rupees through Razorpay.

6.When delivery is complete

Delivery is complete once the Report has been sent to the WhatsApp number or email address you provided. Please save the PDF on your phone or computer, as we do not keep a copy of your Report after delivery (see our Privacy Policy).

7.If you have not received your Report
Check the WhatsApp chat from 93173 65025 and your email inbox, including the Spam, Promotions and Updates folders.
Make sure the WhatsApp number and email you entered at checkout are correct.
If it is still not there after 48 hours, contact us on WhatsApp at 93173 65025 or at ankdarppan@gmail.com with your Razorpay payment ID. We will send it again.

8.Wrong WhatsApp number or email

If you entered a wrong number or email, contact us from your correct number or email with your payment ID, and we will send the Report there. We are not responsible for a Report delivered to a wrong number or email that you entered.

9.Delayed delivery

If your Report has not reached you within 48 hours, contact us and we will send it immediately. Orders are not cancellable or refundable (see our Refund & Cancellation Policy). If we are ever unable to prepare or deliver your Report at all, the amount you paid will be returned.

1.About us

The Website and the reports are operated by Ank Darppan, a proprietorship of Anamika Pathik, having its place of business at HNO 48, Near Gurudwara, Sunny Side, Solan, Himachal Pradesh 173212, India. "We", "us" and "our" refer to Ank Darppan. "You" refers to the person placing the order.

2.The service

We prepare a personalised astrological report based on the Lal Kitab system (the "Report"). The Report is calculated from the birth details you provide and is supplied as a digital PDF of about 65 pages. It typically includes birth and panchang details, Lagna, Lal Kitab, Chandra, Surya, Navamsa (D9) and Varshphal charts, planet-wise analysis, karmic debt (rin) analysis, life area indications and a priority-wise remedy plan. The exact content depends on your chart, and sample pages shown on the Website are illustrations from another person's report.

The Report is a digital product. No physical item is shipped.

3.Who can order

You must be 18 years of age or older to place an order. You may order a Report for another person (for example, a family member) only if you have that person's permission to share their birth details with us. Reports for a child under 18 must be ordered by a parent or legal guardian.

4.Placing an order
Click a "Get My Report" button on the Website. You will be taken to a secure Razorpay payment page.
Enter the details asked for: full name, date of birth, exact time of birth, place of birth, gender, WhatsApp number and email address.
Complete the payment. You will receive a payment confirmation from Razorpay.

Your order is confirmed once payment is successful. We may contact you on WhatsApp, phone or email if any detail is missing or unclear. We may decline an order (and return the amount paid) if we are unable to prepare a Report, for example where the birth details are incomplete or the place of birth cannot be identified.

5.Price and payment
The price of the Report is ₹581 (Indian Rupees), as shown on the Website at the time of your order. The price is inclusive of GST and all other taxes.
Payments are processed by Razorpay Software Private Limited using UPI, debit or credit cards, net banking or wallets. We do not see or store your card, UPI PIN or banking passwords.
Your payment is also subject to Razorpay's terms and the terms of your bank or payment provider.
We may change the price at any time, but a change will not affect an order that has already been paid for.

6.Delivery
The Report is delivered as a PDF to the WhatsApp number and email address you provide.
We deliver within 24–48 hours of a successful payment and complete birth details.
If you have not received your Report within this time, please check your email spam folder and then contact us. We will resend it.
Delivery is complete once the Report has been sent to the WhatsApp number or email address you gave us. Please make sure these are correct, and save the PDF on your device, as we do not keep a copy of your Report after delivery.

7.Your birth details

Lal Kitab calculations depend heavily on the exact time and place of birth. You are responsible for the accuracy of the details you submit. We prepare the Report exactly from the details you provide.

If you notice an error in the details you gave us, tell us as soon as possible. If we have not yet started preparing the Report, we will correct it free of charge.
If the Report has already been prepared using incorrect details that you supplied, a corrected Report can be prepared for an additional fee, which we will tell you before we start.
If the Report contains an error caused by us (for example, a detail typed incorrectly by us), we will correct and resend it free of charge.

8.Nature of astrology: important disclaimer

Astrology, including Lal Kitab, is a traditional system of belief and interpretation. It is not an exact science, and different astrologers and schools may interpret the same chart differently. By ordering, you understand and accept that:

The Report offers guidance and possibilities. It does not guarantee any event, outcome, result or timing.
Scores, ratings and predictions in the Report are interpretive indications and should not be treated as certain.
The Report is not a substitute for professional medical, psychological, legal, financial, investment or tax advice. Do not delay or stop medical treatment, or make major financial, legal, career or relationship decisions, based only on the Report. Please consult a qualified professional.
Any decision you take after reading the Report is your own decision and responsibility.

9.Remedies (upay)

The Report suggests traditional Lal Kitab remedies, such as charity, feeding animals or birds, keeping certain objects, or observing certain practices on specific days. Following any remedy is entirely voluntary.

Do not follow any remedy that is unsafe for your health (for example, fasting during illness or pregnancy, or wearing a metal or stone you are allergic to), that conflicts with the law, or that causes harm to any person or animal.
When feeding animals or birds, use food that is safe for them and follow local rules.
When asked to flow items into water, use only natural, biodegradable items and follow local environmental rules.
Results of remedies depend on many factors, and we do not guarantee any result.

10.Use of the Report and our content

The Report is prepared for your personal, non-commercial use. All text, design, graphics, layouts and logos in the Report and on the Website belong to Ank Darppan or are used with permission. You may print or share the Report with your family. You may not resell, republish, upload to public websites, or use the Report or its format to offer services to others without our written permission.

11.Acceptable use

You agree not to submit another person's details without their permission, provide false payment information, attempt to interfere with the Website's security, or use the Website for any unlawful purpose. We may refuse service where we reasonably believe these Terms have been breached.

12.Limitation of liability

To the extent permitted by law, our total liability to you for any claim relating to an order is limited to the amount you paid for that order. We are not liable for any indirect or consequential loss, or for any decision, action or loss arising from your reliance on astrological interpretations or remedies. Nothing in these Terms limits any right you have under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 that cannot lawfully be limited.

We are not responsible for delays or failures caused by events outside our reasonable control, such as network or payment gateway outages, WhatsApp or email service failures, natural disasters or government action.

13.No cancellation or refund

The Report is a personalised digital product. Orders cannot be cancelled and are not refundable once payment is made. Corrections and payment errors are handled as set out in our Refund & Cancellation Policy.

14.Changes to these Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. The updated version will be posted on this page with a new "Last updated" date. The Terms in force at the time you placed your order apply to that order.

15.Governing law and disputes

These Terms are governed by the laws of India. We will always try to resolve a concern with you directly first. Any dispute that cannot be resolved amicably will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Solan, Himachal Pradesh, without affecting your right to approach a consumer commission under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

16.Contact and grievance officer

For any question, complaint or grievance about an order or these Terms, please contact our Grievance Officer. We will acknowledge your complaint within 48 hours and try to resolve it within one month of receipt, as required by the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.

Each Report is calculated and prepared individually from the birth details you submit, and work on it begins as soon as your payment is received. Because it is a personalised digital product that cannot be returned or resold, all sales are final:

Orders cannot be cancelled after payment.

No refund is given where the Report was prepared using incorrect birth details that you supplied, or delivered to a wrong WhatsApp number or email that you entered.

2.Corrections
Mistake made by us (for example, we entered your birth details incorrectly, or a page is missing or the file will not open): we will correct the Report and re-send it free of charge within 24–48 hours.

This policy does not prevent the return of money that was taken by mistake. If we are unable to prepare or deliver your Report at all, the amount you paid will be returned in the same way.

1.Who we are

Ank Darppan, a proprietorship of Anamika Pathik, HNO 48, Near Gurudwara, Sunny Side, Solan, Himachal Pradesh 173212, India, decides how your personal data is used (the "Data Fiduciary" under Indian law). You can reach us at ankdarppan@gmail.com or 93173 65025.

2.What we collect
Data	Why we need it
Full name and gender	To prepare and personalise your Report
Date, exact time and place of birth	To calculate your kundli and Lal Kitab charts. Place of birth is converted to latitude and longitude
WhatsApp number and email address	To deliver the Report, confirm details and answer your questions
Payment information: amount, Razorpay payment ID, payment status, and the name, email and phone entered at checkout	To confirm your order and keep tax records
Messages you send us	To provide support and resolve complaints

We do not collect your card number, CVV, UPI PIN or net banking password. These are entered directly on Razorpay's secure page. If you order a Report for someone else, please make sure you have their permission to share their details with us.

3.How we use your data
To prepare your personalised Report and deliver it on WhatsApp and email.
To contact you if a birth detail is missing or unclear.
To process payments and corrections, and to maintain accounting and tax records required by law.
To respond to your questions, complaints and requests.
To send you information about other reports or offers only if you have opted in. You can opt out at any time by replying "STOP" or writing to us.

We do not sell, rent or trade your personal data.

4.Consent

By submitting your details and completing payment, you give us consent to use your data for the purposes in section 3. You may withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us. If you withdraw consent before your Report is delivered, we will not be able to prepare it, and our Refund & Cancellation Policy will apply.

5.Who we share your data with

We share only what is needed to provide the service:

Razorpay, to process payments.
WhatsApp and email, to deliver your Report and talk to you.
Government or law enforcement authorities, only when required by law.

6.Sample pages on our Website

We may show pages from real Reports as samples, so that buyers can see what they will receive. We do this only with the client's permission, and we always hide the client's name, date, time and place of birth, and any other details that could identify them. We will never show your Report as a sample without your permission.

7.How long we keep your data
Birth details and your Report: we do not save them in any database or file. They are used only to prepare your Report, and the working copy is deleted once the Report has been delivered. Please save the PDF on your device, because we cannot re-send it from our records.
WhatsApp and email conversations: the details you send us and the Report we deliver stay in our chat or email thread with you, as they do in yours. You can ask us to delete our copy of these messages at any time.
Payment records: payment details are held by Razorpay under its own policy. We keep only the invoice and payment reference that tax and accounting laws require us to keep.

8.Security

We take reasonable steps to protect your data, including password-protected accounts, limiting access to people who need it to prepare your Report, and using secure (HTTPS) connections. Payments are processed by Razorpay, which is PCI-DSS compliant. No method of storage or transfer is completely secure. If a personal data breach occurs that affects you, we will inform you and the Data Protection Board of India as required by law.

10.Children

Our service is meant for people aged 18 and above. Reports for a child under 18 may be ordered only by a parent or legal guardian, who gives consent on the child's behalf. We do not knowingly collect a child's data without this consent, and we do not use children's data for marketing or tracking.

11.Cookies and third-party content

This Website does not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which may see your IP address when the page loads. Links to Razorpay, WhatsApp or other websites are governed by their own privacy policies.

12.Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will always be on this page with its "Last updated" date. If we make a significant change in how we use your data, we will inform you before it applies to you.
